digest.component_or_area: store marker tracking and ensure system

runtime marker churn (archive/unarchive, compaction) surfaces as tracked working-tree deletions, triggering store-read-failure on plan-review/close attestation and merge-abort variants
ensure unit untrack-runtime-markers must remove tracked marker files via git rm --cached in batches and one commit, leaving worktree copies intact for local cache functionality
reader self-heal in list path must re-materialize missing .archived markers when compiled state indicates archived, mirroring existing stale-marker clearing behavior
peers merging the untrack commit must have git delete their tracked worktree marker copies safely because listing excludes archived tickets and markers are fast-path cache only
